data.name: Relicta In Memoriam
data.detailed_description:
💬 We Want Your Feedback!

Try the demo and help us shape the game! Share your thoughts, suggestions, or bug reports in the Steam Community Discussions. Your feedback means the world to us!

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Between faith and superstition, between truth and myth, ancient legends come back to life in the shadows.

Step into the shoes of Lucio, a Vatican investigator tasked with examining cases that defy any rational explanation. Creatures from Italian folklore emerge from forgotten tales, leaving behind clues that are difficult to decipher.

Every investigation will lead you to explore richly detailed settings, gather testimonies, and piece together events through fragmented clues. The truth is never straightforward, and every detail can make the difference.

Investigation and Puzzles

Explore your surroundings, gather evidence, and reconstruct the facts by piecing together what has been seen, said… and hidden. Solve enigmas tied to the cases and let intuition guide you: every observation can bring you closer to the truth or lead you astray.

Strategic Turn-Based Combat

When investigation is not enough, confrontation remains. Face supernatural entities in turn-based combat using spells and special ammunition. Prepare for unpredictable encounters: each enemy follows its own rules and demands focus, timing, and strategy. Execute precise sequences and ancient rituals to overcome threats, rely on your skills, and think your moves through carefully.

Now Everything is in Your Hands

Resources and Preparation

During your investigations, collect and use consumables to adapt to the most dangerous situations. Take a break, have a coffee, smoke a cigar, and gain temporary perks to face what lies ahead.

The line between faith and madness is thinner than anyone wants to believe.

What is discovered cannot be ignored. What is understood cannot be forgotten.

And when that happens… you lose something. Your faith. Or yourself.

This page will be updated continuously throughout the game's development

data.short_description: Relicta In Memoriam is a 2.5D pixel-art noir detective game. Explore the secrets of a world where supernatural phenomena threaten human life. Encounter and battle folklore creatures in intense turn-based combat, gather clues, and solve puzzles to unravel dark mysteries.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 11 pro
  • Processor: 12th Gen Intel Core i7-12700k/3600mhz/12 core
  • Memory: 64 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

content_descriptors.notes: The game features scenes of violence related to gunfights and the use of magic against others. As a mature-themed investigative adventure, the plot and investigations tackle dark themes including murder, drugs, and malevolent or criminal acts. During exploration and case resolution, the player will confront scenarios involving violence as well as cognitive and psychological disorders of the characters involved. Visual violence is mainly linked to combat mechanics and the context of crime scenes, without any representations of a sexual nature or self-harm.
